comment: The Haro v0.11 conformance floor, written BEFORE the court that passes it (the W discipline: fixtures first, prose second). v0.11 grows v0.10 by what the family's Diagnostic Contract (C2 v1.2.0, stzzui/doc/diagnostic-contract.md: six fields, one object carrying `diagnostics`, codes the court's own, cites by stable identifier, empty where no law applies) asks of a court that wants to speak it -- and nothing else: CODE, the language's own stable identifier for a refusal, on a CONSTRAINT, a SYMBOL, a UNION, a MENU, a RANGE, a FORMAT or a REFUSAL; CODES, a code per seat on a DECLARATION (beside MESSAGES) and a code per NAMED word on a REFUSAL; CITES, the pinned instruments a SYMBOL's or a REFUSAL's refusal cites. A code matches C2's format (R1); CODES name a seat (R2) or a NAMED word (R4); a cite is kind:value in the four binding kinds (R3). Every v0.10 fixture still passes: v0.11 refuses nothing v0.10 accepted. Rejects carry the fragment the refusal must contain.

accepts.name: CODE on a CONSTRAINT, a MENU, a UNION, a SYMBOL and a REFUSAL; CITES on a SYMBOL
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE f AS (VERSION "0.11", GRAMMAR "0.11", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".f") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU outcomes AS (WORDS [success, refused], CODE "PARSE") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION terminal AS (VERB "TERMINAL", SEATS [outcome: outcomes]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION step AS (VERB "STEP", SEATS [target: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE UNION node AS (OF [step, terminal], CODE "C5") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE SYMBOL flow AS (KIND "flow", REF "calls", CODE "UNRESOLVED_FLOW", CITES ["article:placement-3.2"]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT one_ending AS (ON terminal, WHEN "outcome absent", MESSAGE "x", CODE "C7") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFUSAL unknown_declaration AS (MESSAGE "the declaration set is closed", CODE "PARSE") RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: CODES: a code per seat on a DECLARATION, a code per NAMED word on a REFUSAL, with CITES
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE f AS (VERSION "0.11", GRAMMAR "0.11", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".f") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION actor AS (VERB "ACTOR", SEATS [role: name, segregated_from: actor?], MESSAGES [segregated_from: "actor {name} is SEGREGATED_FROM '{value}', which is not declared"], CODES [segregated_from: "C9"]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFUSAL unknown_declaration AS (MESSAGE "the declaration set is closed", NAMED [flow: "'FLOW' belongs to ZQL", forever: "'FOREVER' was deleted"], CODES [flow: "FLOW_IS_ZQL", forever: "PARSE"], CITES ["article:placement-3"]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a v0.10 declaration is a v0.11 declaration: v0.10's A1, unchanged
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE f AS (VERSION "0.10", GRAMMAR "0.10", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".f") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE SYMBOL flow AS (KIND "flow", REF "calls", MESSAGE "step {name} invokes '{value}', and the world declares no flow:{value}") RATIONALE "a ZQL flow, declared in the world and never here"
DEFINE DECLARATION invocation AS (VERB "INVOCATION", SEATS [invokes: flow, compensated_by: flow?]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a CODE is a stable uppercase identifier in C2's format
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE f AS (VERSION "0.11", GRAMMAR "0.11", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".f") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION terminal AS (VERB "TERMINAL", SEATS [outcome: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT one_ending AS (ON terminal, WHEN "outcome absent", MESSAGE "x", CODE "c7 missing") RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: is not a code in the Diagnostic Contract's format

rejects.name: CODES on a DECLARATION name its seats
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE f AS (VERSION "0.11", GRAMMAR "0.11", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".f") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION actor AS (VERB "ACTOR", SEATS [role: name], CODES [segregated_from: "C9"]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a cite is kind:value in the four binding kinds: rule, article, right, pattern
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE f AS (VERSION "0.11", GRAMMAR "0.11", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".f") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE SYMBOL flow AS (KIND "flow", CITES ["placement 3.2"]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: is not a cite: kind:value with kind rule, article, right or pattern

rejects.name: CODES on a REFUSAL name its NAMED words
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE f AS (VERSION "0.11", GRAMMAR "0.11", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".f") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFUSAL unknown_declaration AS (MESSAGE "x", NAMED [flow: "x"], CODES [gateway: "PARSE"]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: CODES: 'gateway' is not a NAMED word of unknown_declaration
